name: US House of Representatives, US Department of State, UN Blue Book

credit: US Internal Revenue Service (IRS), Tax Exempt Organization Search (Publication 78, revocation list) and Form 990 e-file data, https://apps.irs.gov/app/eos/

name: Charity Navigator and BBB Wise Giving Alliance
what: Links to each evaluator's own page for a charity. Their ratings are never copied.
